fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.value: Évaluation comparative d'un outil d'automatisation de revues systématiques (LatteReview) via la collection SYNERGY.
fields.quote: First, we evaluate the framework using the SYNERGY collection, a comprehensive pool of article datasets compiled from previous systematic reviews, complete with their original inclusion and exclusion criteria.
fields.note: termes de la valeur absents de la citation : ['LatteReview']

fields.label: Données
fields.value: dataset créé en interrogeant PubMed pour des articles de rapport de cas sur les complications des vaccins COVID-19
fields.quote: Figure 3. (A) A review workflow for screening titles and abstracts from a dataset created by querying PubMed for case report articles on complications of COVID-19 vaccines.

fields.label: Modèles
fields.value: Utilisation d'un agent de revue senior utilisant GPT-4O pour intervenir en cas de désaccord.
fields.quote: A senior reviewer agent, utilizing OpenAI's GPT-4O, intervenes only in cases of disagreement between the junior reviewers to make final inclusion decisions.

fields.label: Limites
fields.value: Les limites incluent l'ambiguïté, le manque de contexte ou d'instructions insuffisantes, nécessitant une supervision humaine.
fields.quote: While LatteReview offers powerful automation capabilities, it's essential to recognize the limitations inherent in any AI-based system.
